items.title: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China
items.summary: The Unitree G1 has found online fame as a relatively affordable robot that can charm a crowd. But can it ever hold down a real job?
items.author: Zeyi Yang

items.title: Tech Visionary Says the Big AI Labs Don’t Get What People Want
items.summary: Tim O’Reilly built a publishing empire that AI is helping to destroy. Yet he loves AI—as long as it’s open source.
items.author: Steven Levy

items.title: These ‘Masturbation Consultants’ Were Hired to Pleasure Themselves With AI
items.summary: Joi AI hired 10 people to masturbate using AI companions as part of a monthlong “wellness” study. The company claims the practice could help “solve male loneliness.”
items.author: Mattha Busby

items.title: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
items.summary: Human-AI marriages are not currently recognized by US law. Some Republican state policymakers are drafting legislation to keep it that way.
items.author: Jason Parham
